title: SQL Server Testcontainer exits with CoInitializeSecurity failure (HRESULT 0x800706b5), breaking EF Core/SqlClient conformance tests
error_pattern:
Class fixture type 'Aspire.Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.Tests.SqlServerContainerFixture' threw in InitializeAsync
DotNet.Testcontainers.Containers.ContainerNotRunningException : Container exited with code 255.
Stderr: ERROR: CoInitializeSecurity failure. (HRESULT 0x800706b5)
Docker.DotNet.DockerApiException : Docker API responded with status code=Conflict, response={"message":"container ... is not running"}
analysis: All 40 EnrichSqlServerTests failures share the identical root cause: the SqlServerContainerFixture's SQL Server 2022 Testcontainer exits with code 255 due to a 'CoInitializeSecurity failure (HRESULT 0x800706b5)' error inside the container, before any test-specific code runs. This is a Docker/container runtime environment issue on the CI runner, not caused by the PR, which does not modify any EF Core SqlServer or SqlClient code.
